snippet.title: Let's Build a Dungeon "Just Build" Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2025
snippet.description: EXCLUSIVE: Let's Build a Dungeon is a game dev sim from the creators of Let's Build a Zoo. Springloaded Games revealed the Just Build mode in #WholesomeDirect, inviting you to create a fantasy world with friends in a stress-free, cozy sandbox. Wishlist! https://s.team/a/2365790 #SummerGameFest #IndieGames
